sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Syntax-only repair budget exhausted before semantic validation: Generator response must contain exactly one BEGIN_SHACL and END_SHACL marker

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the semantic structure before freezing: attach TRF-016-UpperIceWaterlineShape with sh:node to hasUpperIceWaterline so every linked UIWL has exactly one validated waterlineDisplacement with the declared mass unit; the current shape validates only the class and permits missing displacement. Also honor the authoritative requiredOwner metadata: waterlineDisplacement is declared ship-owned, but the candidate constrains it on iceWaterline nodes in both the shape and SPARQL query.
